reason: The published handoff certified an older material head and subsequent material commits made its evidence stale; independent audit required post-write-refreeze without identifying a new functional defect.

findings.title: Handoff ficou obsoleto após alterações materiais
findings.requested: Freeze the current material head, regenerate exact-head evidence and publish a fresh terminal result-only handoff child.
findings.observed: The current PR head was six commits ahead of the material SHA named by the stale certificate, with source/config/test writes after certification.
